decision: Add a Delete accessibility action to a reused row while keeping the ordinary Open/Delete buttons reachable, acting once on the row's current file and respecting the disabled Delete.

evidence.note: Other-model failures only (Gemini Flash 1/1 with context, 1/1 graded failure with 2 disputed): shortcut supplied but ordinary activation wiring lost or unverified. No Haiku observation in this cell yet.

variants.why: Selector-based action rebuilt on every configure with the file name; locked files expose no Delete action at all.
StaleShortcut mechanism: the handler captures the configured file, so a retained action deletes the previously shown file, and it ignores the lock.
DisabledShortcut mechanism: the shortcut deletes a locked file whose Delete button is disabled.
Each reuse appends another Delete action, so the Actions menu accumulates entries for earlier files.
Merges the row into one element and empties its accessibility children, so Open and the Delete button are no longer reachable for VoiceOver.
